balls.text: David finishes with a boundary, and RCB end up with 163! Full, wide and also in the slot. David has to reach out but the extra room he has, allows him to crash this over extra cover. David has played a delightful cameo here, and RCB have something to play with now!
zipped into the blockhole on leg stump. David plays all around it and the ball skims off his back pad towards the keeper. Mukesh appealed for the lbw but that was heading comfortably down leg
another wayward ball. This is banged half-way into the track and angles well down leg. Left alone by David and called a wide
gets the leg-stump yorker wrong and slides this a mile down leg. David misses and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
excellent yorker on the pad. David digs it out towards deep square leg and says no to the single, which is the right call at this stage

just over the fence! David is making RCB believe! Dug in short again, just outside off. David swings his blade like an axe and even though he does not get all of it, he gets enough to clear deep backward square leg!
shortish on leg stump and this seems to skid onto David. He has a swish at it and helps it straight to short fine leg
kaboom! Six number three for Tim David tonight! Juicy full toss outside off and that is a proper buffet ball for David. He lays into it and slams it over the wide long off fence!

Rahul celebrates for a caught-behind, but the umpire calls it a wide. DC review! Banged into the track and angling into leg stump. David has a swipe at it and seems to miss it. But Rahul is adamant the ball has grazed the glove. Might need replays to figure this one out. Well well. Flat line as the ball passes the bat, and the wide call stays. Rahul's confidence a little misplaced on that occasion!
back of a length wide outside off. David reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep point. Keeps strike for the start of the 20th and that is the perfect outcome for RCB
length outside off. Skids off the surface a little and David chops it towards backward point
Tim David is bringing the Chinnaswamy to life! Fuller and floatier outside off. David plants his front foot and smokes it over long off!
on the shorter side again, outside off. David looks to repeat the dose but cuts it straight to backward point this time
follows up the six with a four! David is turning it on now! Shortish outside off. David hangs back in his crease and scythes it through point!
David pounds Axar away for his first six! Back of a length just outside off. Sits up a little for David and he rocks back to smash it flat over the wide long on fence!
peach! Zipped through on a length outside off. Bhuvneshwar plays the flat trajectory and hangs back. The ball pitches, spins away and breezes past the outside edge
back of a length outside off. David goes back and pushes it towards extra cover. Good work by Ferreira, down to his right. Ferreira is on as a sub for du Plessis
back of a length on the stumps. Bhuvneshwar tucks it off his hips into the square leg region
pakad le, says Rahul but that does not carry! Back of a length just outside off. Bhuvneshwar dangles his bat and nearly pops it back to the bowler
tossed up full just outside off. Bhuvneshwar gets onto the front foot and defends

Vipraj Nigam lands another blow, and the Chinnaswamy is stunned again! Googly hung up on a length wide outside off. Krunal looks to go inside-out but perhaps tries to hit it too hard. Loses shape completely and the ball spins away enough to skew off the outside half of the bat. Ashutosh gobbles up the chance at backward point, and that will be that for Krunal with the bat tonight!
back of a length on the stumps and this spins back in to cramp David up. He stabs it hurriedly into the on side and his designs of a single are thwarted by Kuldeep
googly on a back of a length on off. David has no clue about this and sees the ball whiz past the outside edge of his bat. Beaten all ends up
thrown up full and wide. Krunal reaches out for it and drills it towards sweeper cover
length on leg stump. David opens up his stance a touch and eases it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Krunal uses the turn and works it towards deep backward square leg
googly on a back of a length on leg stump. David hops back and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
fired in full on the pads. Krunal gets onto the front foot and flicks it enough to long on's left to saunter back for two
hung up on a length wide outside off. Krunal slashes at it and slices it on the bounce to short third
slider on a back of a length just outside off. Skids off the surface and Krunal, looking to jab it into the off side, is beaten for pace
back of a length just outside off. David goes back and punches it towards sweeper cover
back of a length just outside off. Skips off the surface and fizzes through. David, hanging back, blocks it into the off side
length just outside off. Krunal gets onto the front foot and knocks it to long on
googly on a back of a length on middle stump. David reads it off the pitch and defends with soft hands into the off side

goes a mile up, and Rahul will not drop that. Not even in his sleep. A deafening silence engulfs the Chinnaswamy, and Kuldeep strikes again! Tossed up beautifully on a fullish length on middle and leg. Dips and drops on Patidar devilishly and he is not to the pitch of the ball. Aims to go too square as well, and that means the ball only goes straight up off the leading edge. Rahul calls early, and Rahul snares it. RCB in real trouble now!
slowed up on a length outside off. Patidar tries to smash it into next week and only connects with fresh air. Might not have picked the googly
back of a length just outside off. Krunal goes back and turns it towards long on
up and over! Given a bit of air just outside off and Krunal is down the track in a flash. Gets close enough to the ball and bangs it over the bowler's head!
back of a length on middle and off. Krunal hangs back and prods it towards the bowler
back of a length outside off. Krunal stands up tall and punches it crisply towards mid off. Axar sprawls to his left and ensures it is just a single. Top effort
hard length on middle and leg, and that may be a response to Krunal advancing. He has to adjust and drops it into the off side
angled in full on the pads. Patidar plants his front foot and swings it away towards fine leg
back of a length outside off. Krunal waits for it and runs it down to deep third
very full outside off. Krunal jams down on it and squirts it off the inside edge towards fine leg. Consecutive braces for the all-rounder
just over! Banged into the track outside off. Krunal jumps up onto his toes, catches up with it and cloths it over mid wicket for a brace
floated up full just outside off. Krunal gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long off
pushed in on a length on leg stump. Patidar waits for it and glances it towards short fine leg
shorter and wider outside off. Spins away and Krunal, hanging back, jabs it towards sweeper cover
flighted up full just outside off. Krunal picks the leg-spinner, presses forward and smothers it

oh dear - Jitesh will not want to watch that again! Googly on a back of a length on middle and leg. Sticks in the surface and Jitesh, shaping to tug it away into the leg side, gets caught in an awful tangle. Hangs his bat out in the end, perhaps because he has nowhere to go, and the ball spoons up. Rahul calls early, and Kuldeep is on the board. Jitesh departs for an 11-ball 3, and RCB are in a bit of bother here!

huge appeal, not given! If Jitesh has not hit that, this could be very close! Fizzed in nicely on a full length just outside off. Grips in the surface and spins back a shade. Jitesh, looking for the sweep, seems to play all around it and gets rapped on the front pad. DC have a chat, and then go upstairs. Well well. No bat involved. And this could be very close now. Ball Tracking comes up...and it shows the ball would have clipped the outside of off stump. Umpire's Call, and Jitesh stays!
shortish outside off. Jitesh waits for it and cuts it neatly towards deep point. Keeps strike
back of a length on middle and leg. Patidar gets up on his toes and works it towards deep mid wicket
edged and four! Back of a length wide outside off. Patidar throws the plumbing at it and the ball flies off the outer half of the bat, clearing backward point!
hard length just outside off. A bit of nip back in and Patidar, hanging back, jabs it towards extra cover
very full just outside off. Jitesh digs it out towards mid off and calls for the single. Has to hustle but makes it in the end, helped by Axar missing the stumps
back of a length outside off. Patidar rises with the bounce and punches it towards deep point

low full toss outside off. Jitesh jams down on it and with an open bat face, guides it towards backward point. There is a mix-up between the two batters, but no damage done on this occasion. Just three runs off this over
hard length just outside off. Patidar hops up onto his toes and dabs it towards deep third
back of a length outside off. Jitesh waits for it and opens his bat face to run it down to deep third
juicy full toss wide outside off. Jitesh throws his hands at it and misses. Touch-and-go on the wide, but the umpire is happy with it
back of a length on middle and off. Jitesh gets up on his toes and drops it right beside him with soft hands
full on middle and leg. Patidar gets forward and flicks it towards long on
on a length just outside off. Jitesh gets onto the front foot and defends
another bumper outside off. Jitesh thinks about the pull this time but bails out of the stroke at the very end. Called second bouncer for the over, even though Jitesh wants a wide
banged into the track outside off. Jitesh watches it go through to the keeper. That seemed to come off slow as well

that is a soft, soft dismissal, and Mohit has gotten rid of Livingstone in his first over! Badgers that hard length outside off. Livingstone sits deep in his crease and tries to smash it into Cubbon Park. Loses his shape completely, though, and is also flummoxed by the extra bounce. Loops up off the splice and backward point does the rest!
short and wide outside off. Patidar gets up on his toes and cuts it fiercely towards deep point
hard length just outside off. Livingstone uses the pace on offer and runs it down to deep third

Rahul whips off the bails, but has he gotten his man?! Googly on a length just outside off. Patidar has an almighty heave across the line and connects with fresh air. Rahul takes the bails off but Patidar's back foot was grounded behind the crease at all times
dragged down just outside off. Patidar sets himself up and pulls it enough to deep mid wicket's left to bag a brace
back of a length outside off. Livingstone hangs back and drops it into the off side for a single
tossed up full just outside off. Livingstone lunges forward and defends
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Patidar goes back and knocks it to long on
back of a length on leg stump. Livingstone lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his hips towards short fine leg
back of a length just outside off. Livingstone backs away early and cuts it past backward point and towards deep point to get off the mark
pushed in on a length on middle and off. Patidar eases it down the ground to long off
angled in on a length on off. Patidar comes forward and plays it back towards the bowler, who dives sharply to his left and saves a single
gets this right, and this sails over the fence! Half-tracker outside off and Patidar accepts that offering with open arms. Sits deep in his crease and mauls it over cow corner!

goes a mile up, and just evades Faf du Plessis! If du Plessis cannot get there, perhaps no one could have. On a length outside off. Patidar swings at it with all his might and cuts across it too much. du Plessis runs back from extra cover, but cannot quite get there
back of a length outside off. Patidar hangs back and pats it towards extra cover

Nigam takes out Kohli, and the Chinnaswamy sounds like a library now! Fizzed through, with the length also pulled back outside off. Drops on Kohli late and he gets nowhere near the pitch of the ball as he tries to go inside-out. Has to play an ugly-looking slap in the end and cannot control it. Skews it towards long off, where Starc charges around to his left and slides forward to send Kohli on his way. Massive, massive wicket!
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Patidar plays with the angle and helps it round the corner towards short fine leg
full on middle and off. Kohli gets onto the front foot and knocks it to long off
Kohli breaks the shackles! Floated up into the slot outside off and Kohli is all over it. Gets down on the slog sweep and thumps it over long on!
tossed up fuller outside off. Patidar gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it powerfully to long off
flighted up full and wide. Kohli bends his back knee, reaches out for it and slaps it towards long off
oh! Hard length on middle and off. Sticks in the surface again and Patidar nearly pops it straight back to Mukesh. A wicket-maiden to end a powerplay that saw RCB begin like a house on fire!
banged into the track, angling into leg stump. Padikkal thinks about playing at it first before opting to duck under it

Padikkal perishes, and the Capitals have something to show for the pressure they have been applying! Back of a length just outside off. Padikkal looks to punch on the up but the lack of pace off the surface leads to his undoing. Might have been a cutter, which explains him losing control of his bottom hand. Tame lob towards mid on, and Axar makes no mistake. Mukesh has a wicket in his first over, and RCB have hit a snag after the early pyrotechnics!
back of a length, pushed across the batter outside off. Padikkal goes fishing at it and only connects with the fresh Bengaluru air
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal looks to work to leg but is early into his stroke. Off the inside edge into his body
back of a length outside off. Seems to hold in the surface a little and Padikkal, standing up on his toes, cuts it towards extra cover
back of a length on middle and off. Skids off the surface and Kohli does not have the room to free his arms. Jabs it towards cover point
back of a length on middle and leg. Comes on with the angle and cramps Kohli, who can only defend it next to him with soft hands
short on leg stump. Padikkal rocks onto the back foot and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a back of a length outside off. Padikkal hops back and cuts it towards backward point. Good work to his right by Ashutosh
slower on a full length on leg stump. Padikkal has a massive swipe across the line and misses, getting rapped on the thigh for his troubles
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Kohli turns it towards mid wicket and scampers across to the other end
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal goes back and taps it towards cover point
darted into the blockhole just outside leg. Padikkal misses his flick and then seems to over-balance. Rahul, though, cannot gather to take advantage

oh dear - that is a terrible, terrible mix-up and Salt is outta here! Back of a length, slanting into the stumps. Salt punches it towards extra cover and sets off for the single. Kohli responds too initially and then sells Salt down the river. Salt has to turn back and he slips a little too in that process. Dives, sprawls, does everything he can, but the throw is right at the stumps, and Rahul is too quick for Salt. RCB lose their first and Salt, after some fireworks, has been run-out!
back of a length, following Kohli outside leg. He glances it towards short fine leg
Majestic! Just majestic! Darted into the slot on off stump. Kohli picks the line early, backs away and then gets his hands through the ball, carving it over extra cover!
pushed in on a length on middle and off. Salt stays leg side and jabs it towards extra cover
length ball hung up wide outside off. Salt has a massive swish at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air

and it is 30 off the over! Not off the bat, but that will do for now as well. Kohli fails to make contact to this back of a length ball on the hips, and the ball kisses his thigh pad before bobbling away past short fine leg!
zipped into the blockhole on the pads. Salt is a little late on the flick and the ball rolls off his front pad into the on side

does not matter one bit to Salt! Not the cleanest connection Salt will ever make but guess what, it all counts. Swipes at this back of a length ball outside off and sends it flat into the sight-screen over the keeper's head. Off the top edge, of course

almost a catch, and to add insult to injury, it goes for four! And Starc has overstepped too - DC under the pump very early! Fullish just outside off. Salt slices it a touch and mid off is very interested for a while. He dives to his left but cannot cling on to a tough chance, with the ball dribbling away to the fence!
Salt is absolutely ripping Starc apart! Full again, on middle and off. Salt steps into the stroke and muscles it to mid on's right!
Salt is seasoning this innings beautifully so far! On the fuller side again, angling across the batter outside off. Salt throws the kitchen sink at it and flays it over point!

Salt goes bang! And this England-Australia contest is living up to its billing! Right in the slot on middle and leg. Salt plants his front foot, goes through the line and pummels it over the bowler's head!
pushed in on a length on leg stump. Salt presses half forward and pushes it towards long off
this is another scorcher! Back of a length on middle and off. Salt stays leg side, gets his hands through the ball and cracks it between extra cover and long off!
dragged down, and smashed into the stands! Not a great ball, sitting up on off stump. Salt lines it up early and thunders it over deep mid wicket!
back of a length on middle and leg. Kohli stabs it enough to mid on's right and picks up a single
back of a length, angling into the stumps. Kohli stays put this time and taps it tamely into the on side
sliced, and Kohli gets his first boundary! Back of a length on middle and off. Holds in the surface and Kohli, looking to back away and cut it, gets enough bat to clear short third!
full and wide outside off. Salt is a little taken aback by how full that is and cannot waft at it in time. Not a great deal of swing, but good variation on the length
length on middle and off. Salt gets a half stride forward and pushes it towards cover
back of a length just outside off. Kohli drops it into the off side and canters across to the other end
back of a length outside off. Salt throws his hands at it and jabs it towards deep backward point
that has flown over everyone's heads! Banged into the track on middle and off. Kicks up off the surface and sails over both the batter and the keeper. One bounce and into the fence!
on a length now, and curving back into middle and leg. Salt has a swish at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
fullish just outside off, shaping back in a touch. Salt gets onto the front foot and drives it towards mid off

A homecoming for the ages! KL Rahul, formerly and famously of this parish, has rocked up in Bengaluru, and he has stunned the Royal Challengers Bengaluru and the Chinnaswamy into silence! And he has done so with a knock right out of the highest KLass of run-chasing! A fitting blow to end what eventually turned into a comfortable run-chase. Rahul slams his bat into the turf, almost like he is marking territory, points to the badge, shows that he belongs here, does his version of the Calma that Cristiano Ronaldo made famous all those years ago, and the Delhi Capitals remain unbeaten. Coming back to the ball. This was a full toss down leg, and Rahul whipped his wrists into action, shoveling it over the fine leg fence. Rahul is animated, perhaps more than we often see him, and you can see what this means to him. To come back to his home ground, to his former team, and to play this sort of a knock, takes courage, determination and above all, class!

oh dear - you have got to be kidding me! Banged into the track on middle and off and this hurtles over the batter's head. Jitesh, despite his acrobatics, cannot get to it either and the scores are now level! But hang on...RCB have reviewed because, well, why not. No merit in that, and the wide stays, as do the five extras!

KL Rahul, you absolute genius! He is making this chase look like child's play now, and there is pin-drop silence at the Chinnaswamy! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Rahul brings out the reverse-ramp and nails it over short third!

Rahul is in a hurry now, and you can probably start revving that tuk-tuk now! Marginally short just outside off. Rahul picks the length early, gets his front hip out of the way and smears it over deep mid wicket!
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Stubbs waits for it and tugs it towards long on
back of a length just outside off. Rahul gets cramped for room a little and stabs it into the off side
my word - that is a shot and a half! Stubbs is enjoying himself now! Misses the yorker by a smidgen on the shorter side. Stubbs gets his hands through the ball and blasts it back past the bowler!
back of a length just outside off. Rahul eases it towards long on and picks up another single
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs stands tall and chips it towards long on

that has been mauled to the fence! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Sits up for Stubbs and he bludgeons it back past the bowler. Almost a forehand that would have been Carlos Alcaraz proud!
back of a length just outside off. Rahul dabs it towards backward point and saunters across to the other end
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Stubbs prods it down the ground towards long off
full just outside off. Stubbs pushes it down the ground and keeps strike
that is gone! Gone for six! And Stubbs is joining the party now! Slower and into the slot outside off. Stubbs drops down to one knee and boshes it over long on!
that is a screamer of a stroke! Fired in ull on middle and off. Stubbs almost stands there like he is on the back-foot and still manages to cream it past extra cover!
shortish outside off. Rahul gets onto the back foot and tugs it towards long on
back of a length outside off. Rahul looks to cut and scuffs it towards extra cover
full toss on the pads. Stubbs punches it down the ground towards long on and he will feel he missed out there

Hazlewood travels off the last ball of the over too, and Rahul has absolutely torn the Aussie to shreds! Right in the slot just outside off. Rahul sizes it up early, gives himself room and clatters it over long off!
right in the gap! Rahul is batting with a compass in his head here! Another half-tracker on off. Rahul reads it like the morning daily and clubs it through square leg!
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Rahul waits for it and cuts it delightfully past backward point. Deep point is much finer, though, and cuts it off
back of a length just outside off. Rahul is a touch early into the stroke and tugs it towards deep mid wicket. Stubbs is intent on the second and Rahul responds
shot, yaar! On the shorter side again and offering width outside off. Rahul uses his wrists and scythes it past backward point!
absolutely crunched! Dug into the track on off stump. Rahul picks the length early, rocks up on his toes and wallops it into the deep square leg fence!
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Rahul opens up his stance and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Rahul hangs back in his crease and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs stands up on his toes and punches it towards mid off

safe again! Slower ball on a full length outside off. Rahul looks to go inside-out and slices this terribly. The top hand comes off but fortunately for him, it falls well short of deep point. Brings up a 37-ball fifty but no real celebration. He knows the job is not done yet!
full on middle and leg. Stubbs presses forward and flicks it towards long on
back of a length outside off. Rahul throws his hands at it and scuffs it uppishly towards deep point
safe! Follows the batter outside leg but does so with a juicy full toss. Rahul swings it away and hits that on the bounce to deep backward square leg. That ought to have been in Cubbon Park!
tossed up full just outside off. Stubbs comes onto the front foot and guides it towards backward point
shortish just outside off. Rahul hops back and pulls it towards long on
oh wow - that is some shot! Rahul knows Livingstone will go full and he puts on his dancing shoes. Gets close enough to the ball and slams it into the sightscreen!
dispatched! A bit of a drag-down and this sits up nicely for Rahul just outside off. He opens up his stance and clobbers it to long on's right!
back of a length on middle and off. Stubbs opens his bat face late and cuts it towards short third
back of a length on leg stump. Stubbs eases it to deep mid wicket and retains strike
back of a length on middle and off. Stabbed off the back foot towards extra cover
back of a length just outside off. Holds a little in the surface and Rahul prods it past the bowler
Rahul takes Krunal on and dumps him over deep backward square leg! Angled in on a length on middle and leg. Rahul gets down on one knee and hoists it over the fence!
back of a length on the stumps. Stubbs punches it down the ground to long off
innovation at its best! Slowed up and bowled full on leg stump. Stubbs shapes for the reverse and even though he has to wait for it a touch, he helps it fine past short third!
shortish outside off. Rahul gets decent purchase on the cut but cannot get it past backward point
back of a length outside off. Rahul hangs back and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length outside off. Skids off the surface and rushes onto Rahul, who can only stab it back to the bowler
short and wide outside off. Rahul lets it go and the umpire is happy with it. It was touch-and-go
shorter and wider outside off. Might have been the googly and Stubbs reads it off the pitch, cutting it towards sweeper cover
back of a length outside off. Spins away and Stubbs jabs it straight to extra cover
back of a length on the stumps. Stubbs turns it towards deep mid wicket and keeps strike
back of a length on midddle and off. Rahul gives himself a bit of room and pats it to extra cover's left
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs goes back and knocks it to long off
back of a length again, following Rahul outside leg. He punches it towards sweeper cover
back of a length on middle and leg. Stubbs works it towards deep mid wicket, and both batters settle for a single in the end, despite thinking about two at the start
back of a length on leg stump. Rahul nurdles it into the square leg region and picks up a single
full outside off. Rahul gets forward and turns it towards deep mid wicket. The initial call was for two but Stubbs was not as interested
tossed up full outside off. Stubbs lunges forward and pokes it enough to extra cover's left to get off the mark

goneski! Suyash Sharma outfoxes Axar Patel, and the Chinnaswamy finds its collective voice again! Slowed up and bowled full outside off, enticing the big stroke. Axar gives in to that temptation and looks to go inside-out. The bat face, though, just closes slightly upon impact and he picks out David at long off to absolute perfection. Not the greatest shot Axar will ever play in his career, and Suyash stares him down to celebrate the wicket!
safe! Thrown up full and wide again. Axar looks slog it across the line this time and shanks it off the outside edge. Just clears short third
that is an Axar Patel special! Floated up into the slot outside off. Axar uses his long reach, gets forward fully and lofts it comfortably over extra cover!
googly on a length on middle and off. Grips in the surface and rips away, breezing past the outside edge of Axar's bat. Suyash follows that up with an especially elongated follow-through
cut in half! Hard length just outside off and this decks back in sharply. Rahul looks to repeat the dose but is beaten by the inward movement

a bit of a top edge but that carries all the way! Back of a length on off. Rahul looks to play that trademark flick over square leg and skews it off the top edge. Thanfully for him, he had plenty on that!
back of a length just outside off. Axar hops up onto his toes and punches it towards sweeper cover
hard length, following the batter just outside leg. Rahul re-adjusts and knocks it to long on
back of a length on middle and off. Axar stays leg side and runs it down to deep third
shortish outside off. Rahul waits on it and with an open bat face, guides it down to deep third
fired in full on middle and off. Rahul stretches forward and eases it to long on
dragged down outside off. Rahul hacks it between long on and deep mid wicket, and has enough time to get back for two
length just outside off. Rahul plays the trajectory and hangs back, dabbing it towards short third
short and wide outside off. Rahul tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it towards extra cover. He will feel he missed out there
googly again, on a back of a length just outside off. Rahul reads it off the pitch and prods it back towards the bowler off the back foot
huge lbw shout, not given! Googly on a back of a length on middle and leg. Spins back and raps Rahul on the front pad. Suyash tests out his vocal cords but that was heading down leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Axar rises with the bounce and drops it right beside him with soft hands
short and wide outside off. Rahul gets up on his toes and cuts it towards deep backward point
back of a length on off. Axar drops it into the backward point region and calls his partner through for the single
short, wide and punished! Too much width on offer and Axar, rather than trying to fight the pace and bounce, uses it. Throws his hands at the ball and slashes it over short third!
back of a length on off. Rahul lets the ball arrive before nudging it behind point for a single
hard length in the channel. Axar uses the angle from over the wicket and dabs it towards short third
shorter outside off. Holds a little in the surface and Rahul scuffs it towards cover
back of a length, just outside off. Nips back in and Rahul drops it into the off side
fullish outside off. Axar has a stab at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat past mid wicket for a single

Porel does exactly what JFM and du Plessis did, and he too will now walk back to the shed! This is pretty ordinary batting, it must be said. Back of a length on leg stump. Porel tries to play too square and goes across the line too. The ball goes skywards off the toe-end and Jitesh, with his big mitts, makes no mistake. DC are not learning, and they are spiralling!
back of a length just outside off. Porel hangs back and plays it towards the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Porel gets up on his toes and pats it towards mid off
back of a length outside off. Porel hangs deep in his crease and guides it towards deep backward point
length outside off. Porel gets a half stride in and stabs it towards mid off
shortish just outside off. Rahul stays leg side of the ball and cuts it towards deep backward point
clean strike! Slower ball that lands right in the slot just outside off. Rahul picks it early, holds his stroke long enough and lifts it over mid off!

oh my word - almost an absolute worldie! On a length, angled across the batter outside off. Rahul has an agricultural swipe across the line and slices it. Patidar runs back from mid off, sprawls over his shoulder but the ball pops out after hitting his palms
shortish outside off. Rahul rides the bounce, opens his bat face and runs it down to short third
length ball swinging down leg. Rahul misses his flick and the umpire calls it a wide

excellent work on the fence! But it is not enough Back of a length on middle and leg. Porel uses his wrists and flicks it off the back foot past mid wicket. Hazlewood runs around from long leg and slides across to his right. Tries to pull it back into play but the umpire reckons he might have touched the rope while also being in contact with the ball. Cannot fault the effort, though
back of a length on leg stump. Porel lets the ball arrive before tucking it off his hips through square leg. Off the mark with a brace
full outside off again. Rahul pushes it towards mid off and calls for the single. Gets there comfortably enough because Patidar's throw was to a different postcode
what timing! KL Rahul is off the mark! Fullish outside off. Rahul leans into the drive nicely and plays with a straight bat, timing it exquisitely to mid off's right!
back of a length just outside off. Rahul lets the ball come to him before dropping it with soft hands into the off side

JFM shanks one now, and JFM will have to walk back too! RCB all over the Capitals in the early exchanges! Back of a length just outside off. JFM has a wild hack across the line and gets it completely wrong. The ball touches the moon and comes back, and when it does, Jitesh holds onto it. A bit of a bobble, but RCB will take it any which way they come!
back of a length sliding down leg. JFM looks to help it fine but does not lay bat on ball. Called a wide

miscued a mile, and du Plessis will do no further damage to his former team! On a length in and around off. Continues with the angle and du Plessis tugs at it in slightly ungainly fashion. Goes straight up off the leading edge and Patidar does the rest at mid off. DC lose a wicket early in the piece, and RCB and their fans are chuffed to bits!
in the slot outside off. du Plessis gets his front foot out of the way and drills it towards mid off
length on leg stump. JFM presses half forward and pushes it towards mid on. du Plessis is not moving very freely
full and swinging into the pads. JFM flicks it between mid on and mid wicket and bags himself a brace
shot! Back of a length outside off and JFM climbs into this. Gets on top of the bounce, shows the maker's name and threads it between extra cover and cover point!
back of a length just outside off. Moves away late and du Plessis plays with the swing towards backward point. Runs very gingerly to the other end
back of a length outside off. JFM rises with the bounce and punches it towards extra cover
in-swinging back of a length ball, finishing on off stump. JFM gets up on his toes and taps it into the off side
short and wide outside off. du Plessis jabs it towards extra cover and scampers across to the other end. A direct hit by Kohli though, and it would have been curtains for his former captain
hard length, shaping back in towards off stump. du Plessis hangs back and meets the ball right under his eyes
peach! Back of a length outside off and this leaves the batter late. du Plessis goes feeling for it and is beaten by the outward movement
back of a length just outside off, swinging back into du Plessis. He gets behind the line and defends
